comments: Internal discovery so far: A cookie domain needs to have at least two dots to be marked as valid. This is the reason why FF + CR throws. Next steps would be to dig into CR/FF to find out why they are not adding a dot under some conditions and apply this logic on our cookie parsing api testing side.

Same here (https://github.com/blockprotocol/blockprotocol/pull/753) after updating Playwright from 1.27.1 to 1.28.0-alpha-nov-10-2022:

```
Error: Protocol error (Storage.setCookies): Invalid cookie fields
```

This happens in Chromium, FF and Webkit.

My setup used to have a local patch to fix some cookie issues in Webkit (https://github.com/blockprotocol/blockprotocol/pull/455#discussion_r927957190). This patch worked in 1.24.0...1.27.1 but could not be applied to 1.28.0-alpha-nov-10-2022, possibly due to internal refactoring in Playwright. The removal of the patch does not explain failures in all other browser engines.

Happy to try new alpha versions if needed. As of now, I'm not sure I'll be able to update to 1.28 when it's released.
